reason: Full independent first review verified the trusted SHA-256 and read all 380 lines of the pinned raw. The accepted receipt, candidate and suggestions agree; all five quotes are exact at their stated locators; and the canonical URL, raw provenance, company route and existing concept targets resolve. The candidate accurately preserves the Braintree-hosted dLocal Payment Orchestration identity, Braintree-owned transaction-operation boundary, dual-provider and environment-specific setup, mandatory customer data, seven-day authorization window, reconciliation states, fulfillment caution, and the limits against treating this guide as independent dLocal authority or as execution, settlement or funding proof. Second, raw line 355 marks Turkey decimals supported while its Additional notes cell says `amount` must be an integer; the candidate routes to decimal handling but does not surface this unresolved capability conflict, so the raw route cannot answer whether a Turkey amount may contain decimals. Third, the provider index now exposes the dedicated [[braintree-orchestration]] retrieval hub, but the candidate and reciprocal suggestion still route this central Orchestration source only through the broad payment-platform concept; a reader entering the hub to find the dLocal connector cannot discover it there. These corrections are narrow, use unchanged evidence, and do not require importing Forward API constraints or expanding routine matrices.
